ns2:section.sectionText: Intro to Contemporary Dance, 3 hours. Overview of major works, figures, and trends responsible for shaping dance as an evolving contemporary art form. The course will have lecture, viewing, discussion, and experiential (studio participation) components. For non-dance majors. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
